slides.title: OpenFinance
slides.subtitle: Human-controlled invoice delivery between independent AR and AP applications
slides.narration: Supplier accounts receivable teams lose hours re-entering invoices into customer portals and copying the results back. OpenFinance lets independently authenticated AR and AP applications complete that workflow through WebMCP, without a custom point-to-point integration or shared credentials.

slides.eyebrow: THE BROWSER AGENT IS THE BRIDGE
slides.title: Independent systems. Shared human intent.
slides.subtitle: OpenFinance AR  ↔  ChatGPT + human  ↔  Acme AP
slides.narration: These are genuinely separate applications, authentication sessions, authorization boundaries, and databases. The ChatGPT browser agent is the bridge. Each site exposes only narrow, authenticated tools, while the human controls intent and every consequential transfer.

slides.title: Submit all Acme invoices that are ready.
bullets: Documents remain in AR until approval
slides.narration: The operator asks one question: submit all Acme invoices that are ready for their AP portal. OpenFinance returns three portal-ready invoices. A fourth stays excluded because it is missing a purchase order. No document crosses sites yet.

slides.title: Discover and reconcile live buyer rules
slides.narration: The agent previews the exact destination, invoices, purchase orders, amounts, and documents. After informed transfer approval, Acme exposes its live requirements and purchase-order balances. Read-only validation creates no receipt, audit event, reservation, or balance change.

slides.title: $25,670 ready · $12,900 excluded
slides.narration: Two invoices pass. Invoice 10482 is eighteen thousand four hundred twenty dollars, and invoice 10491 is seven thousand two hundred fifty dollars. Invoice 10507 is excluded because it exceeds PO 8890's remaining balance by two thousand nine hundred dollars. The human separately approves only the valid twenty-five-thousand-six-hundred-seventy-dollar batch.

slides.title: Atomic submission with verifiable receipts
slides.narration: Acme atomically submits exactly those two invoices, locks and decrements the matching purchase-order balances, and returns two portal references. Fingerprint-bound idempotency makes identical retries safe and rejects any changed payload that reuses the key.

slides.title: Both applications show the same outcome
slides.narration: The agent verifies the receipts, records the same references and the actionable exception back in OpenFinance, and both live interfaces update immediately. Each company retains its own authoritative state and audit trail. The browser conversation coordinates the outcome; it does not become a hidden finance system.

slides.title: OpenFinance
slides.subtitle: Interoperability without bespoke integrations or shared credentials
slides.narration: OpenFinance demonstrates a WebMCP-native future where people provide intent and judgment, agents handle discovery and reconciliation, and independent businesses remain secure and in control. One browser session becomes a transparent, human-governed interoperability layer across the B2B web.
